posts.author: kyivindependent.com
posts.text:
⚡️️ European Commission approves proposal to provide additional $49.5 billion to Ukraine.

The European Commission on Nov. 18 approved a set of legislative proposals to provide up to €45 billion ($49.5 billion) in additional financial support to Ukraine in 2027.
posts.editorReason: Editor: Concrete, consequential diplomacy and finance: the European Commission approved proposals for up to €45 billion ($49.5 billion) in additional Ukraine support in 2027. It is the later, approval-stage version of the EU funding story, so it beats the earlier 'exclusive' post.

posts.author: noelreports.com
posts.text: The Kremlin says Putin briefed Xi Jinping on the war in Ukraine. Peskov confirmed Ukraine will dominate Putin's discussions with Trump and Xi at the summit in China. A formal Putin-Trump meeting now appears unlikely, while work continues on a joint trilateral statement. #Ukraine
posts.editorReason: Editor: Reports Kremlin statements on the China summit: Putin briefed Xi on Ukraine, Peskov said Ukraine will dominate the talks, a formal Putin-Trump meeting looks unlikely, and a trilateral statement is being worked on. Relevant to US foreign policy and great-power diplomacy.
